answer: The mirror counter is kept in bridge and crystal shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 55 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
